## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::SenderTransferNotConsenter` — the caller is not the stream's recipient.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_recipient_can_execute_a_sender_transfer`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::only_the_recipient_can_execute_a_sender_transfer). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// SenderTransferNotConsenter — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, DAY, 10 * DAY, false);
let new_sender = soroban_sdk::Address::generate(&f.env);
f.client.mock_all_auths().propose_sender_transfer(
    &f.sender,
    &id,
    &new_sender,
    &1,
    &false,
);
// The incoming sender is not the party whose consent executes it.
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_accept_sender_transfer(&new_sender, &id, &1)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked only_the_recipient_can_execute_a_sender_transfer
```

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Only the stream's current recipient can execute or consent to a sender transfer; have the recipient sign the consent.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#19-consented-sender-role-transfer)
